newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa vulnerable after recent rally.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa vulnerable after recent rally.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa looks vulnerable after its recent rally, technical analysts said.
"I personally think the market remains vulnerable, although it has rallied in the last 10 days," Adrian Haylor, technical analyst at Sucden said.
"I've tended to view the recent strength as a corrective rally, with the 1,020 stg level as the extreme of the correction," Haylor said.
Current levels put the market right in the middle of the range between strong support at 980 stg and resistance at about 1,060 stg, he said.
He put immediate resistance at 1,020 on the basis of the convergence point of moving averages.
"It's not really in an uptrend or a downtrend," Sucden's Haylor said. "It's probably in a sideways trend."
Traders called cocoa to open at around three stg down.
New York cocoa prices ended weaker in uneventful dealings on Monday, pressured by speculative and origin selling, traders said.

New York displayed little reaction to a report from Merrill Lynch that said the world's 1996/97 cocoa supply deficit is low as 50,000 tonnes, far smaller than the 100,000-200,000 tonne range seen earlier in the year.
